meta.project: Multilingual and Explainable ESG Intelligence System

literature_references.authors: Peng Chen, Shaowei Chen, Jie Liu
literature_references.relevance: Provides a state-of-the-art framework for identifying aspects, opinions, and sentiment triplets in a single end-to-end model, directly supporting the foundation for C1 and RQ1.1.

literature_references.relevance: Directly addresses the challenge of cross-lingual transfer in ASTE using code-switching techniques, justifying the bilingual approach for Indonesian-English ESG coverage in C3.

literature_references.title: Knowledge Distillation for Machine Translation
literature_references.authors: Zhen Li, Dan Qu, Chaojie Xie, Wei Xue-juan

contributions: C8: Large-scale ESG LLM benchmark (30+ models)

literature_references.relevance: Demonstrates that imitating brain memory hierarchy improves long-context processing with significantly lower inference memory, providing the technical basis for C13 and RQ2.2.
